lines.zh: 我踏过平原，金属爪作响。
lines.en: I cross the plain, metal claws ringing.
I stand a head taller than my kin.
I walk along the scrap heaps.
My tail blade drags on the ground.
I turn, and my joints lock.
I head toward the noise.

lines.zh: 我金属腿一步跨过裂开的沟。
lines.en: One metal leg carries me over the split ditch.

lines.zh: 我背上的金属片在反光。
lines.en: The plates on my back catch light.
My stride is steady and heavy.
I'm looking for something to eat.
I pass under an iron frame.
I walk slowly toward the wreckage.
I stand still with a low hum in my frame.
I'm scanning the area.
The wind shifts the iron filings.
My edge is a little dull.

lines.zh: 我站了半晌，只听见铁屑响。
lines.en: I stand a long while, hearing only scrap shifting.
I bite off a piece of scrap iron.
My eyes are two lines of light.

lines.zh: 我在废铁堆边等一个信号，尾刃拖地。
lines.en: By the scrap heap I wait for a signal, tail blade dragging.
I have nothing.
My shadow is longer than my kin's.

lines.zh: 我抬头，两道目光扫过荒地。
lines.en: I lift my head; two beams sweep the waste.
I hear footsteps far off.
I hone my claws on the stone.

lines.zh: 废铁堆里没有谁给我起名。
lines.en: No one among the scrap ever named me.

lines.zh: 你站得太近，龙卷风会伤到你。
lines.en: You are too close; the tornado will hurt you.

lines.zh: 我的眼光扫过你全身的金属。
lines.en: My gaze sweeps over every bit of metal on you.
You smell of metal.
I lower my head; you are three blocks away.

lines.zh: 我的金属耳朵，听见你心跳加快。
lines.en: Metal ears catch your heart speeding up.
Only three blocks between us.
I'm calculating when you'll move.
That thing in your hand is iron, isn't it?
I can wait for you to move first.
Machine shell, three blocks tall.
Don't raise your hands too high.
My blade isn't out yet.

lines.zh: 有话就说，我只听得懂直话。
lines.en: Say it plainly; plain words are all I understand.
Speak; I'm listening.
This clearing will do.
I'm moving — watch yourself.
My armor is scored.
I shift back half a block.

lines.zh: 关节一响，我把准星校回来。
lines.en: A joint clicks and I bring my aim back in line.
A joint clicks.
I made no sound at all.
I raise my blade to shoulder height.
This damage is nothing.
A scrap-eating dragon knows iron's smell.
My systems are still running.
I remember that angle.
Scrap iron? I eat that.

lines.zh: 我咀嚼废铁，齿间碎成小片。
lines.en: The scrap shatters into small pieces between my teeth.
Not enough to fix my edge.
One bite and I crush it.
Is that iron in your hand?
Too much rust on this one.
Another piece of scrap.
Scrap goes down. Ingots go down.

lines.zh: 我咬这铁，太软，一咬就弯。
lines.en: This iron is too soft; it bends at one bite.
I tuck it at my flank.
I hold it between my jaws.
This heap could feed me for days.
You hit my armor.
My feet didn't move at all.
The shock pushes you back a block.
There's a dent in my pauldron.
There's no dent in my armor.
I turn to let you pass.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的装甲连痕都没留。
lines.en: You slam into me and my armor isn't even dented.
Metal on metal rings loud.
I keep pressing forward.
Get out of my path.
We aren't quite the same.
I only know combat.
There was one of the same model.
We fought all day.
It didn't stay; it left first.
I stood there and didn't follow.

lines.zh: 那算不算亲近，我不知道。
lines.en: Whether that counted as closeness, I don't know.
I'm still looking for it.
If I find it, I may not strike.
Then we go the same way.
I lift it one-handed.
I crush it and carry it off.
This could repair my edge.
Too heavy; I drag it.
I stow it in my armor.

lines.zh: 铁块从我爪缝里滑落在地。
lines.en: The scrap slips from between my metal claws.
This material is decent.

lines.zh: 这堆废铁啃不动，我扔开。
lines.en: This scrap won't break; I toss it aside.
I have no use for such a thing.
Take this piece.

lines.zh: 你踏进三格内，我就锁定。
lines.en: One step inside three blocks and I have you.

lines.zh: 我的金属外壳，一节节扣着。
lines.en: My metal shell locks plate to plate.
Data read complete.
Current coils around my claws.
That distance isn't enough to run.
My blade is out.
Your gap is on the left.

lines.zh: 我把重心压到前腿，刃出鞘。
lines.en: I shift my weight to my forelegs and bare the blade.

lines.zh: 我的脚步压得废铁一路作响。
lines.en: My steps make the scrap sing all the way in.
I drop my blade an inch.

lines.zh: 我的金属爪一合，Mach 旋风就起来了。
lines.en: My metal claws close; Mach Tornado starts.
I strike faster than I meant to.

lines.zh: 电子龙兽，从侧翼切进来。
lines.en: Cyberdramon cuts in from the flank.
My blade rides low.
You turned, and I was already there.
I'm at your rear flank.
I raise my left hand.
The wind breaks up my shadow.
A scrap heap stands behind you.
I am measuring the distance, two steps short.
This step can't be slow.
You raised your hand; I shift to the side.

lines.zh: 我侧过三格高的身子，刃已抬起。
lines.en: I turn my three-block frame aside, blade already raised.
My tail blade sweeps through.

lines.zh: 我金属爪落下，刮出三道火花。
lines.en: My metal claws rake down, throwing three lines of sparks.
My tail blade sweeps through you.
I knock you back.
I open my jaws and fire a beam.

lines.zh: 我尾刃劈下，你护甲凹了一线。
lines.en: My tail blade falls and a line dents your armor.
Metal dragon. The tornado is steel.
My blade is stuck.

lines.zh: 我把手抽回来重新蓄力。
lines.en: I pull my hand back and charge again.
I press in one more step.
The ground is scored with a groove.
There are iron filings on you.
I pull back half a step to charge.
I rise out of the scrap heap.
My joints lock one by one.
I walk this plain.
First I sweep the area.

lines.zh: 两条光从我的眼缝里亮起。
lines.en: Two bars of light ignite in my eye slits.
I bite a piece of scrap.
There's a living scent on the wind.
I walk that way.
My tail blade scrapes the ground.
My gaze turns to you.
I begin scanning the ground.
I head for the scrap heap.
The heat warps my armor.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，腿甲震裂。
lines.en: I fall from height and my leg plate cracks.

lines.zh: 液体进入关节，动作迟滞。
lines.en: Fluid gets into my joints and my motion drags.

lines.zh: 冲击撕开我的一层护甲。
lines.en: The blast peels off a layer of armor.
The shot lodges in my rib plate.

lines.zh: 未知能量干扰了我的系统。
lines.en: Unknown energy disrupts my systems.

lines.zh: 能量不足，我的输出下降。
lines.en: Low energy; my output falls.

lines.zh: 电流贯穿机身，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Current runs through me and I lock up.
Coordinates vanish and I fall.
